Book: (i) characters of distinct irreducibles are linearly independent; (ii) for semisimple A, they form a basis of (A/[A,A])*. Part (i) is exactly proven as characters_linearly_independent. For part (ii), characters_basis_semisimple proves that every tracial functional f (satisfying f(ab)=f(ba)) lies in span{χᵢ}. Since (A/[A,A])* is exactly the space of tracial functionals on A, this combined with part (i) (linear independence) gives that the characters are a basis. The formulation as 'every tracial f ∈ span' is equivalent to the book's 'form a basis of (A/[A,A])*' (spanning direction) when combined with linear independence. Faithful-but-terse.
